'''2000 Nevada State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Las Vegas, Nevada on 8 April 2000. [[Matt Berta]] won it. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d491">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-las-vegas-nv-4-8-00-state-tournamentd491/ las-vegas-nv-4-8-00-state-tournament], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 9 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-las-vegas-nv-4-8-00-state-tournamentd491/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Berta]]
